motion_and_interactions.preloader_animation: Progress bar from 0% to 100% in 1.4s, then slideUp curtain reveal into the hero section.
motion_and_interactions.scroll_reveal: Staggered fade-up (`opacity: 0, y: 30` -> `opacity: 1, y: 0`) with 0.6s spring physics.
motion_and_interactions.card_hover: Subtle -translate-y-2 lift, 1px border highlight shift from #1E293B to #F5C253, soft gold box-shadow glow [0 12px 30px rgba(245,194,83,0.15)].
motion_and_interactions.button_interactions: Pill button hover: scale(1.03), brightness(1.08), active click scale(0.97).
motion_and_interactions.accordion_toggle: Smooth height spring animation using motion layout.
motion_and_interactions.reduced_motion_fallback: All motion wrappers fallback to instantaneous opacity transition if `prefers-reduced-motion` is active.

testing_attributes.convention: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, accordions, modals, tabs) MUST contain kebab-case data-testid attributes

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace font import in frontend/src/index.css with @fontsource-variable/barlow and @fontsource-variable/mulish or define system font stacks Barlow 700 + Mulish 400 for maximum fidelity.
2. Maintain strict navy (#071328) base with gold (#E6A635 / #F5C253) accents and crisp white surfaces. Ensure parent brand 'Garud Zep Rupantaram' & 'Rupantaram Academy' identity is prominent.

3. Implement the full suite of required sections: Hero, About Academy, 8 Key Outcomes, Who Should Join (6 traits), 3-Day Journey Timeline (Day 1 Discover, Day 2 Build, Day 3 Design), 8-Pillar Learning Method, 8 Measurable Benefits, 6 FAQ Accordion items, Final CTA, and Footer.
4. Deliver an on-load preloader matching the Rupantaram gradient #c8102e -> #f0a500 with navy text #1b2a4a that dismisses smoothly.
5. Use interactive Shadcn Dialogs for 'Enroll Now' and 'Download Brochure' with active Sonner toast notifications upon submission.
6. Include all data-testid attributes for automated testing verification.
